F-02: 13 safety-critical pairs, hazards H-03, H-04, H-06, goals SG-03, SG-04, SG-06, highest C. F-03: 10 safety-critical pairs, hazards H-01, H-02, H-05, goals SG-01, SG-02, SG-05, highest C. F-04: 9 safety-critical pairs, hazards H-04, H-09, goals SG-04, SG-08, highest B. F-05: 8 safety-critical pairs, hazards H-07, goals SG-02, SG-06, highest C. F-06: 1 safety-critical pairs, hazards H-04, goals SG-04, highest A. F-07: 0 safety-critical pairs, hazards none, goals none, highest —. F-08: 4 safety-critical pairs, hazards H-02, H-08, goals SG-02, SG-07, highest C. F-09: 0 safety-critical pairs, hazards none, goals none, highest —.
svg.text: Figure 4-9 · The item's functions in the hazard view
The functions of WP-C-01 §2.1, each with its 14 guide words classified (§2 step 2), the hazards its safety-critical pairs reach (§4) and the goals they lead to (§6)
safety-critical, expanded: highest ASIL of its rows

Guide words: M01 no function · M02 stops functioning · M03 unrequested function · M04 function stuck · M05 excessive function · M06 partial function · M07 functions early · M08 functions late · M09 function applies too short · M10 function
applies too long · M11 function is delayed · M12 inverse function · M13 erratic or intermittent · M14 function is uneven

Every pair keeps its written reason in the workbook (tab 11) and hara-function-guideword.csv. Reference scope: Experimental Mode (F-02X) is in the variant workbook (§5.11). Ratings as proposed, before I3 confirmation.

g.text: Terms: ACC adaptive cruise control · ASIL Automotive Safety Integrity Level, A (lowest) to D (highest), from ISO 26262 · F-nn function of the item (WP-C-01 §2.1), F-01…F-09 · H-nn hazard (HARA) · I0–I3 independence

level of a review, I0 (none, e.g. the author or an AI) to I3 (independent organisation) · M01–M14 guide word M01…M14 of the HARA (no function, unrequested, excessive, …) · NA not applicable · NSC not safety-critical

· QM quality managed: no ASIL; ordinary quality processes suffice · SG-nn safety goal (HARA §6) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software,
V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
